input.quote: This Agreement will be governed by the substantive laws of the State of New York, without regard for its conflict of laws provisions.
input.rationale: § 14.3 selects the substantive laws of the State of New York, which is our preferred governing law. The document contains no arbitration provision (no hits for "arbitration") and no foreign or vendor-home-jurisdiction forum, so there is no walk-away risk. The only shortfall is that the clause is silent on venue rather than conferring exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County; with New York law chosen and no competing forum selection, disputes default to courts of competent jurisdiction, so this is a minor sub-element short of the preferred wording and is noted rather than redlined. Related provisions (§ 14.4 jury waiver, § 14.14 limitations period) are noted only and not flagged under this rule.
